name: hai
description: Build-root manifest for Vercel. The application lives in app/; this file exists so the repository root can be the build root, which it must be because the Next.js app reads content/ from the parent of its own directory (see app/src/lib/content.ts). Vercel detects a framework by looking for it in the dependencies of the package.json at the build root, and reads packageManager from the same file — without this, the build fails first on an incompatible pnpm and then on 'No Next.js version detected'. The dependency below is never installed: vercel.json overrides installCommand to run pnpm inside app/.
